item.title: Why Financial Transparency in the Race for UN Boss Matters
item.description: All the candidates currently running for the job of United Nations secretary-general were asked to declare who is paying for their campaigns. None of the responses from the eight candidates provide names and numbers. The submitted campaign-financing notices of all the candidates come from a nominating government or mission; none bears the candidate’s own signature ... Read more

item.title: UN and Partners Work to Stabilize Health and WASH Systems in Venezuela Following Deadly Earthquakes
item.description: Two months after devastating twin earthquakes struck northern and central Venezuela on June 24, the humanitarian community has been on the frontlines, delivering lifesaving aid and focusing efforts on sustainable paths for rehabilitation. item.description: When the UN High-level Political Forum on Sustainable Development (HLPF) ended in New York in July, it took two recorded votes for states to pass a ministerial declaration that, until recently, would have been adopted without controversy. item.title: Guterres urges leaders to invest in peace as conflicts deepen
item.description: The UN Secretary-General appealed on Wednesday for world leaders to invest in peace as violence, division and conflict exacerbate suffering worldwide.

item.title: Record number of attacks on education, global fund warns
item.description: While September traditionally marks the start of the school year across the northern hemisphere, a staggering 93 million children are not in class at all amid an unprecedented number of attacks on learning, education experts warned on Wednesday.

item.title: Plight of Afghans going ‘from bad to worse’, but the world is looking away: Türk
item.description: Since the Taliban returned to power in 2021, the plight of Afghans has only deteriorated, with millions impoverished while authorities violate basic human rights daily.

item.title: UN hails Libya election deal as Security Council urges Libyans to seize the moment
item.description: The UN Security Council has welcomed a breakthrough agreement between Libya's rival political blocs, calling it "an important step" towards the country's first national elections in over a decade – while pressing all sides to move quickly from paper to practice.

item.title: Flood-ravaged Nepal calls for climate justice
item.description: Nepal’s call for financial compensation following recent deadly floods underlines the need to help countries that contribute the least to climate change – but are increasingly grappling with its most lethal consequences, the top UN official in the country said on Wednesday.
